title: FAQ — Speed Test Questions Answered | CialloSpeed
metaDesc: How accurate are online speed tests? Why is the result lower than your plan? Does testing use data? CialloSpeed's FAQ helps you test correctly and get accurate results.
ogDesc: Is the test accurate? Why lower than your plan? Answers inside.

mainEntity.name: Are the speed test results accurate?

acceptedAnswer.text: CialloSpeed uses dual test engines: Cloudflare's official speed test kernel (testing via the nearest of its global edge nodes) and OpenSpeedTest™ (multi-threaded concurrency to saturate your bandwidth), both MIT open source. But any speed test is affected by time of day, Wi-Fi conditions and node location. We recommend cross-validating with both engines and averaging multiple runs.

mainEntity.name: Why is the measured speed lower than my broadband plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common causes: Wi-Fi signal loss or interference, an underpowered router, low-grade Ethernet cabling, a test node on another carrier's network, peak-hour congestion on shared links, and protocol overhead (about 4%-10%). For a baseline, connect straight to the modem with an Ethernet cable and test again.

mainEntity.name: My Wi-Fi result is very different from the wired one — is that normal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Wi-Fi is limited by distance, walls, channel congestion and your device's network card, so real-world Wi-Fi throughput is typically a fraction of wired speed. To saturate a gigabit plan, connect important devices by wire.

mainEntity.name: Does a speed test use my data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A speed test transfers real data (usually tens to hundreds of MB per run), so mind your data cap when testing on mobile data.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to install a plugin or an app?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. CialloSpeed is HTML5-based and the test engine runs entirely in your browser — just open it on a phone, tablet, computer or smart TV.

mainEntity.name: Will my test records be uploaded?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Test history is stored only in your browser's localStorage and never uploaded to any server. Clearing your browser data deletes it.

mainEntity.name: How do I get more accurate results?

acceptedAnswer.text: 1. Prefer a wired connection; 2. Stop devices and apps that are downloading, backing up or streaming; 3. Avoid the evening peak; 4. Average multiple runs; 5. Move closer to the router or use the 5GHz band.
Completely free, with no ads and no sign-up. The test engines are provided by the open source projects Cloudflare Speedtest and OpenSpeedTest™ (both MIT licensed).
